This small plot is just a corner of my land, only a tiny piece. I never went to school, so I do what my father did and what my neighbors do. I have no cash to spend on fertilizer from the shop for such a small piece — I will put the manure from my cattle on it, that costs me nothing. I will use the seed I saved from last harvest, like always, because buying new seed from the town is risky and I do not know if it will grow well here.
